description: Transmembrane helix identity matrix and cytosolic tail lengths across the BAP31 family
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd, itertools
TMs={
'Yet1':['LFLLLTVEMVMLFIFVLPLPF','QIKTIIFITGCLVGLLFIDSW','MYISGFILYFSICIPTVMSIV'],
'Yet2':['VYLAVLFSLLVIEMAILFILV','KFRTYMVGIMIFVGLLFIDSW','VYISGFIIYFYICILTVMSIL'],
'Yet3':['LVFAILVVEIFMFSILALPIP','TVQVAIKCVLGFILLLFIDCI','GITLFLTFVVVRTFGLVIELL'],
'BAP29':['AVATFLYAEIGLILIFCLPFI','IATFWNKAFLTIIILLIVLFL','LYISGFSLFFWLVLRRLVTLI'],
'BAP31':['AVATFLYAEVFVVLLLCIPFI','LVSYGNTFFVVLIVILVLLVI','LYIAGFSLLLSFLLRRLVTLI']}
TAIL={'Yet1':81,'Yet2':36,'Yet3':72,'BAP29':117,'BAP31':123}
names=list(TMs)
def pid(a,b): return sum(x==y for x,y in zip(a,b))/len(a)*100
rows=[]
for a,b in itertools.combinations(names,2):
    v=[pid(TMs[a][k],TMs[b][k]) for k in range(3)]
    rows.append({'pair':f"{a}-{b}",'TM1':round(v[0],1),'TM2':round(v[1],1),'TM3':round(v[2],1),'mean':round(np.mean(v),1)})
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('mean',ascending=False)
print("Per-TM percent identity (UniProt-annotated 21-residue helices, ungapped):")
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nCytosolic tail after last TM (aa):", TAIL)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
M=np.full((5,5),np.nan)
for i,a in enumerate(names):
    for j,b in enumerate(names):
        M[i,j]=np.mean([pid(TMs[a][k],TMs[b][k]) for k in range(3)])
im=ax[0].imshow(M,cmap='YlGnBu',vmin=0,vmax=100)
ax[0].set_xticks(range(5));ax[0].set_xticklabels(names,rotation=30);ax[0].set_yticks(range(5));ax[0].set_yticklabels(names)
for i in range(5):
    for j in range(5): ax[0].text(j,i,f"{M[i,j]:.0f}",ha='center',va='center',fontsize=9,color='k' if M[i,j]<70 else 'w')
ax[0].set_title('Mean identity across the three TM helices (%)',fontsize=10); plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax[0],fraction=.046)
b=ax[1].bar(names,[TAIL[n] for n in names],color=['#4878a8','#c0504d','#2e7d32','#9e9e9e','#9e9e9e'])
for p,n in zip(b,names): ax[1].text(p.get_x()+p.get_width()/2,p.get_height()+2,f"{TAIL[n]}",ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylabel('cytosolic residues after last TM'); ax[1].set_title('Length of the cytosolic coiled-coil region',fontsize=10)
plt.suptitle('Yet2p pairs with Yet1p on transmembrane sequence but has the shortest cytosolic tail in the family',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
